rca of the issue: Previously in iter24: functional-updater `setDoc(cur=>{latest=cur; return cur;})` race under React 18 batching meant `latest` was undefined when api.put fired, producing 422 with a Pydantic error array which the sonner toast tried to render as a React child, crashing the ErrorBoundary. Fix in iter25 (verified): use `doc` directly (safe — handler captured latest render state) and coerce toast payload to string. Fix confirmed by (a) no crash under repeated saves, (b) 200 response persisting to DB, (c) blank-body save still produces 200 (backend permissive) and defaults reappear.
